thread:
Elena (CS): Hey team — customer acct_12345 reports dashboard vs invoice mismatch for Feb month-end. Dashboard totals: 1,240,321 tokens. Invoice INV-2026-02-099 shows 1,329,410 tokens and a ProPlus line; customer insists they were on Pro then upgraded mid-month. Can someone triage?

Ingrid (Billing): @Elena thanks for flagging. Do we have the billing ledger export and the raw usage query? Also, any screenshots of dashboard line items (plan labels)? :mag:

Elena (CS): Uploaded screenshot to the ticket. Quick notes: upgrade timestamp 2026-02-15T23:58:12Z. Dashboard UI shows two lines (Pro / ProPlus) split across the cutoff, but invoice consolidated to one ProPlus line with a different unit price. I pulled the dashboard SQL quickly:

```sql
-- dashboard aggregation used by the UI
SELECT plan_alias, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_aggregates
WHERE account_id='acct_12345' AND month='2026-02'
GROUP BY plan_alias;
```

Elena (CS): Dashboard query result (from UI export): Pro: 742,101 tokens; ProPlus: 498,220 tokens. Invoice ledger export (billing team csv) shows a single line labeled `proplus` with 1,329,410 tokens.

Maya (Support): Noting this customer was escalated to priority. They want a root cause and whether they'll be credited. I can draft an interim response if we get an ETA.

Dennis (Eng): I'll take a look at the billing worker that composes invoice lines. Two quick hypotheses: 1) plan alias mapping was mutated by a backfill so events after reconciliation got remapped; 2) there was a duplicate backfill that added ledger rows and invoice de-duped differently from dashboard.

Dennis (Eng): Can someone paste the billing-worker logs around invoice generation time? Also the mapping table snapshot: `plan_alias_map`. Suspect aliasing: `pro -> pro_legacy` vs `proplus_alt -> proplus`.

Ingrid (Billing): Here are two snippets from our pipeline logs (sanitized):

```
billing-worker INFO: generate_invoice(account=acct_12345, month=2026-02) started (2026-03-01T02:05:12Z)
billing-processor WARN: alias_map lookup missing for plan_id=proplus_alt -> fell back to 'pro' (2026-02-28T23:59:59Z)
billing-processor ERROR: duplicate_ledger_row detected ledger_row_id=lr_98765 (2026-03-01T02:06:04Z)
```

Ingrid (Billing): The CSV I exported is the post-invoice aggregation; I also exported ledger lines and there are two rows for 2026-02 with different plan_ids but same usage_id referencing a backfill job.

Dennis (Eng): That `alias_map lookup missing` is the smoking gun. We recently pushed a mapping migration (PR #485) that renamed some transitional plan ids. If invoice generation fell back to older alias, aggregation rules changed. Dashboard uses `usage_aggregates` which is populated after plan normalisation, while invoice uses raw ledger rows + alias map at bill time. If the alias_map changed between aggregation and bill time, you'll see misaligned grouping.

Dennis (Eng): Repro steps for engineering:
1) dump ledger rows for acct_12345 for month 2026-02:
```sql
SELECT * FROM ledger_rows WHERE account_id='acct_12345' AND month='2026-02' ORDER BY ts;
```
2) run invoice aggregation with current alias map:
```bash
python -m billing.aggregate --account acct_12345 --month 2026-02 --alias-map /etc/billing/alias_map.yaml
```
3) compare to dashboard aggregation query (dashboard uses normalized usage_aggregates table).
```

Maya (Support): If this is the root cause, recommended mitigation for now? Customer needs a clear answer + possible credit.

Ingrid (Billing): Short-term: issue a provisional credit for the delta (invoice - dashboard) and mark as pending while we confirm root cause. Longer-term: ensure alias_map is snapshot-locked at invoice generation time and add a reconciliation job that compares invoice token totals vs dashboard aggregates before finalizing invoice.

Dennis (Eng): I'll run the repro locally and check for duplicated backfill rows and alias resolver logic. Assigning to myself — will update in 2 hours.

sre-bot: Deployment queued: alias-map-migration rollback (deploy/1234) scheduled in 30 minutes.

Elena (CS): Thanks — I'll message the customer with an interim note: "We're investigating an internal plan-mapping discrepancy that may have caused line consolidation on your invoice. We'll follow up with a correction or credit within 48 hours." :pray:

Ingrid (Billing): Logged follow-up ticket BILL-5472 for reissue/credit path. Attaching ledger export and invoice CSV.

Dennis (Eng): Quick update — found duplicated ledger rows from a backfill job run 2026-02-28T23:58 which inserted rows with `plan_id=proplus_alt`. The alias_map during invoice rollup did fallback and merged differently. Repro successful locally. Next steps: 1) dedupe ledger rows for invoice run, 2) snapshot alias_map at bill start, 3) re-generate invoice draft for acct_12345 and validate token totals match dashboard aggregates.

Maya (Support): I'll draft the customer credit language and prepare a PR for refunds once billing confirms amount.

Elena (CS): Great — keep me posted. I'll wait for confirm before sending formal apology + credit.

Dennis (Eng): Marking this resolved in thread for now. Will post final reconciliation numbers once re-run completes.
